about: Round 11: every log through one open dialog, then the window of frequency against time: for every log the maps of the unfiltered gyro as the window comes up; for the first also at eight other settings of its two smoothing lists and with the colour scale ending at 0 dB; for the last, a flight, also the maps of the filtered gyro and at two settings of the lists; a picture of the window and a vector copy of every plot each time.
